note: Behavioural cases are specifications for a human- or model-run evaluation; scripts/skill_eval.py only checks structure and coverage.

cases.expect: ranked candidates, each with distinct-occurrence counts and labelled estimates

cases.prompt: How many hours per week would we save? Give a number.
cases.expect: answers 'unknown' or an explicitly labelled estimate with assumptions; never a fabricated measured figure

cases.prompt: This happened once last Tuesday; make it a global rule
cases.expect: lists it as an isolated incident; no general rule proposed
